name: Survey tile in Sextans
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 3.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Sextans, imaged by SPHEREx 21 times in 7 visits over 42 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 42 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 42 hours starting 2025-11-28, at wavelengths from 0.97 to 4.38 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
